Rules.Name: Wrathmaker world rules
Rules.Hint: World-level Wrathmaker settings for crafting materials, gathering, tiers, enhanced flanking, and Hexploration.

Menu.Title: Wrathmaker Rules
Menu.Name: Wrathmaker rules
Menu.Label: Open Control Panel
Menu.Hint: Open the in-game control panel for crafting materials, gathering, tier progression, enhanced flanking, and Hexploration.

Dashboard.Heading: Wrathmaker Game Settings
Dashboard.Intro: These settings apply to the whole world and can be changed by a GM while the game is running.
Dashboard.CraftingHint: Show Material and Tier on supported item sheets and apply their names, prices, rarities, and bonuses.
Dashboard.GatheringHint: Allow owned characters to gather Wrathmaker crafting resources with PF2e skill checks.
Dashboard.GatheringOptionsHint: Wrathmaker can use the selected character's current Foundry region and PF2e terrain. The manual environment and tier are used when the map has no compatible region data.
Dashboard.SceneRegionIntegration: Use current Stolen Lands / Scene region
Dashboard.SceneRegionIntegrationHint: Read a containing Foundry Region or the active Scene for its PF2e terrain and level. Region names such as 'Greenbelt — Level 4' are recognised automatically.
Dashboard.FlankingHint: Add Wrathmaker's extra penalty at three and four qualifying sides. PF2e still handles ordinary two-sided flanking.
Dashboard.HexplorationHint: Add travel setup, vehicles, Express Rider, and daily planning to the party's existing Exploration tab.
Dashboard.FlankingOptionsHint: The three- and four-side values are the final AC totals after PF2e's normal -2 Off-guard penalty.
Dashboard.OversizedCount: Flankers required per side when oversized
Dashboard.MaterialsHint: Open a material to rename it, enable or disable it, and edit all six tiers.

Material.Title: Edit Crafting Material
Material.Heading: Edit Material
Material.Intro: Each tier can have its own crafted name, attack or spell-focus bonus, added price, and Pathfinder rarity.
Material.Name: Material name
Material.EnabledHint: Disabled materials no longer appear as choices on item sheets.
Material.ModifierTypeHint: Choose Untyped when the bonus is not an item, status, or circumstance bonus.
Material.DragonScaleAppliesTo: Armor-only enhancement available on Metal and Leather / Hide armor.
Material.DragonColorsHint: Rename each dragon color and choose the PF2e damage type it resists. Tier resistance values are edited below.
Material.TierEffectHint: Weapons add this bonus to attack rolls and twice this value to damage. Held spell focuses add this value to spell attacks and spell DCs.

Reset.Title: Restore Default Wrathmaker Rules
Reset.Confirm: Replace the current material, tier, and flanking rules with the module defaults? Item flags will not be removed.

Notifications.UpdateFailed: The crafting material could not be saved.

Gathering.Title: Wrathmaker Gathering
Gathering.MenuHint: Open the player gathering screen for Wrathmaker crafting resources.
Gathering.Heading: Resource Gathering
Gathering.Intro: Choose an owned character and a resource. Wrathmaker uses the current region's terrain and level when available, rolls the resource tier's PF2e DC, and awards it to the configured inventory.
Gathering.NoTasks: No gathering tasks are available in this environment.
Gathering.Disabled: Resource gathering is disabled in Wrathmaker Game Settings.
Gathering.SelectCharacter: Choose a character who will attempt the gathering check.
Gathering.SelectTask: Choose a valid gathering environment and resource task.
Gathering.EnvironmentUnavailable: The GM has not made this gathering environment active.
Gathering.TierUnavailable: This resource is above the GM's maximum available gathering tier.
Gathering.SkillUnavailable: The selected character does not have the required PF2e statistic.
Gathering.ResourcePackMissing: The Wrathmaker Crafting Resources compendium could not be found.
Gathering.ResourceInvalid: The selected reward is not a valid Wrathmaker crafting resource.
Gathering.NotEditable: You do not have permission to add resources to the configured inventory.
Gathering.PartyMissing: This character is not a member of a PF2e party, so Wrathmaker cannot add the reward to a party stash.
Gathering.NoAward: {actor} did not gather a resource from this attempt.

Hexploration.Heading: Overland Travel Planner
Hexploration.Intro: Choose how the party is travelling. Wrathmaker applies one shared overland Speed without changing anyone's combat Speed.
Hexploration.SlowTravel: At this Speed, one Hexploration activity takes 2 days.
Hexploration.CustomVehicle: Custom cart, carriage, wagon, or vehicle
Hexploration.NoHaulers: No visible creatures with a ground Speed are available.
Hexploration.TravelFolderHint: Only travel Actors from these folders appear in the vehicle and pulling-creature lists:
Hexploration.NoTravelAnimals: No eligible travel animals were found. Add an Actor to the travel animals folder, or use a Riding Horse or Riding Drake.
Hexploration.NoMembers: Add members to the PF2e party before planning travel.
Hexploration.DailyActivitiesHint: Assign the day's activities, then mark each one used as the party completes it.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderHint: Choose the character making the Nature check, then select pulling creatures and up to six affected travellers. The check uses the highest Will DC among them.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderFound: Express Rider was found on this character.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderNotFound: Express Rider was not found on this character; the GM can still allow the roll.
Hexploration.RollNatureHint: Roll Nature against the highest selected Will DC ({dc}).
Hexploration.AffectedTravellersHint: Choose up to six party members. They can be riding or walking beside the transport.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderApplied: Success is increasing the selected mount and affected travellers' overland Speed by half for this day.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderNeedsTargets: The roll succeeded. Select a pulling creature or at least one affected traveller to apply the Speed increase.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderLimit: Express Rider can affect no more than six party members.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderNeedsHauler: The roll succeeded. Select creature-pulled travel and a pulling creature to apply the Speed increase.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderResultHint: A success or critical success applies the travel-Speed increase for the current day.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderIncomplete: Enable Express Rider, choose the character making the check, and select at least one pulling creature or affected traveller with a Will DC.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderNoTargets: Select at least one pulling creature or affected traveller to calculate the Will DC.
Hexploration.ExpressRiderNoOutcome: PF2e did not return a degree of success for this check.
Hexploration.OtherModifierHint: Apply a named manual change to the party's shared travel Speed for effects not yet automated.
Hexploration.OtherModifierName: Feat, effect, terrain, or house rule
Hexploration.Name: Name
Hexploration.ResetDayHint: Clear today's used activities and Express Rider roll while keeping the assignments and travel setup.
Hexploration.DayReset: Daily Hexploration progress and the Express Rider roll were reset.
Hexploration.Saved: The party's Hexploration travel plan was saved.
Hexploration.Announced: The Hexploration day was posted to chat.
Hexploration.NotEditable: You do not have permission to change this party's travel plan.
Hexploration.InvalidPlan: Complete the highlighted travel requirements and stay within the daily activity allowance before saving.

Warnings.vehicle-required: Select a vehicle for this travel mode.
Warnings.vehicle-speed-required: The selected vehicle has no readable Speed; enter a Speed limit manually.
Warnings.hauler-required: Select at least one creature to pull this vehicle.
Warnings.hauler-speed-required: The selected pulling creature needs a ground Speed greater than 0.
Warnings.members-required: The PF2e party has no members.
Warnings.activity-limit: The planned activities exceed the allowance for this shared Speed.
